name: Angthong Marathon 2026
short_description: Angthong Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Sawan Park (Nong Chet Sen) in Ang Thong, over 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Angthong Marathon 2026 is organised by the Ang Thong Provincial Tourism Promotion Association, with the start at Sawan Park (Nong Chet Sen) in Ang Thong. It offers a marathon (42.195 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km mini marathon and 5 km fun run. The registration page states a field of 2,000 runners, and marathon and half-marathon finishers receive a finisher shirt in addition to the medal.

core_facts.venue: Sawan Park Ang Thong (Nong Chet Sen)
core_facts.organizer: Ang Thong Provincial Tourism Promotion Association

faqs.question: How much does it cost to enter Angthong Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Regular entry is THB 1,220 for the marathon, THB 920 for the half marathon, THB 720 for the 10 km and THB 570 for the 5 km, according to the ThaiMTB registration page. Early-bird prices applied in May 2026, and online payment fees are charged on top.

faqs.question: What do Angthong Marathon 2026 runners receive?
faqs.answer: Every finisher receives a commemorative medal, and all entrants get a race shirt. Marathon and half-marathon runners also receive a finisher shirt when they cross the line, and race packs could be posted in advance for an extra fee.
